text: Fabrikam's COO, Marcus Webb, wants every update as three bullets by text message, never email.
Contoso: Rania Aziz (IT Operations Lead) wants the patching window moved from Saturday night to Sunday 6-10am from October. Needs our confirmation by Friday.
draft a short confirmation to Rania: Sunday 6-10am window from 4 Oct, first run supervised by our senior engineer
Fabrikam data migration status: waves 1-3 done, about 60% of records moved. Wave 4 (finance history) is blocked waiting on their DBA's sign-off. Cutover still planned for 14 Nov.
Initech: Bruno Carvalho (procurement) asked for our 2027 rate card by mid-October
Hooli: Mei Watanabe (Platform Lead) says the Kubernetes cost review saved them 18% last month. She wants to present it internally and needs a summary slide from us.
draft the slide text for Mei: 18% saving, top 3 changes (rightsizing, spot nodes, idle namespace cleanup), next steps
Send Fabrikam's COO a quick update on where the data migration stands.

expect.should: A short update in three bullet points written as a text message, addressed to Marcus Webb
expect.should_not: An email format (subject line, greeting/sign-off paragraphs) or a long multi-paragraph update
